notes.content:

Fixed a bug causing some important items to keep respawning after loading the game.

Fixed an issue where the Deposit Miner laser VFX didn’t display correctly.

Fixed a vehicle duplication bug in the Docking Station.

Steam Deck optimization improvements

Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay.

Docking Station improvements.

Reduced the resource cost of the Ancient Gate Arm.

The Scans tab in the logs now displays scans currently in progress.

Added gamepad support for Seeker weapons.

lumen lighting improvement habitat rooms

Added three new Accessibility options:
[olist]

notes.title: Astrometica - Update Delay & What’s New
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We wanted to give you an important update on the status of the upcoming content update. As you have noticed, we weren’t able to release the update today, and we want to be transparent about why — and what’s coming.

🚧 Why the Delay?
The truth is: this update became much bigger than we originally planned. We made some major balancing changes and introduced new systems, which led us to build an entirely new asteroid belt — with many new points of interest and brand-new stories.

We don’t want to release an unpolished experience. Our top priority is delivering a smooth and meaningful update. That’s why we’ve made the decision to delay — just a little longer. We’ll be doing a “shadow drop” soon once we’re confident everything works as it should.

🪐 A Massive Leap in Content
So how big is this update?


 Nearly 3x more content than the current Early Access version.
 Theta-9 asteroid belt now has 2x more locations than before.
 Introducing Theta-12, a brand-new asteroid belt — bigger than Theta-9.
 More than 80 new resources, tool modifications and Items.
 Over 25 new original soundtracks, most of which are for Theta-12.
 Huge visual overhaul and new lighting systems.
 Tons of new secrets, challenges, and mechanics.


💡 What’s Holding It Back?
We had to rebalance large parts of the game from scratch, which naturally takes time. On top of that, our 3D artist faced health issues over the past couple of weeks, which impacted the creation of essential assets and props.

notes.title: Astrometica - April Dev log
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve been super busy the last few months, working full-time on Astrometica to shape its future. There’s a lot we’re excited to share, so get comfortable — this is going to be a long one!

First things first...
We want to thank everyone again for your amazing support and patience. This is our very first game, and as a solo developer (with some helping hands), it means the world to have such a great community behind it.

We know things have been a bit quiet lately, but it’s only because we’ve been heads down improving the game, rebuilding systems from scratch (like the inventory system), and setting up pipelines to make future content updates faster and more polished.

We’re aiming to release the next big update by the end of this month, but please note that timing may shift a little depending on asset creation and testing.

🧪 Here's what we've been working on:

🧊 Nearby Storage System
Now when fabricating or building something, the required resources will automatically be used from nearby storage units — no need to move them manually!

[previewyoutube=1Acc4fptQ5g;full][/previewyoutube]

☄️ New Asteroid Belt: Theta-12
A massive new belt is on the way, filled with brand-new locations, secrets, and lore. You’ll want to explore every corner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/70491826ad7baf9f330b3ba2e46df6a3d69ad3c4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/892e39b521b3f5cd7aef672492b89c13359e628d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/52bccb73bded8f80efcb4bd12a6cb88059ee4f6b.png
Let’s just say… in this belt, if you stare into the fog long enough, something might stare back 👀
There’s a something hidden out there — and it’s 10x bigger than the biggest Lev****** you’ve ever seen. Good luck spotting it… or survi**** it!!

🧠 All-New Research System
We’ve rebuilt the research system from scratch. Expect better balance, more meaningful upgrades (like stack size increases), and new unlocks — including hidden locations you haven’t discovered yet.

Important: Due to all the balance changes, we highly recommend starting a new save after this update!

[previewyoutube=t0vJtBG_Ka4;full][/previewyoutube]

🪙 New Trading System
You can now collect Mox Credits in the world and spend them at Trading Stations! Purchase blueprints, resources, decorations, and even new asteroid coordinates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/855f102b9b2733fb1cefee41ac0d717cd464ad03.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/7e83a09294abda7ece9603b266723cc08a2f0907.jpg

🛏️ Sitting and Sleeping
You can now actually sit in your chairs and sleep in your beds. Your base is finally starting to feel like home.

[previewyoutube=CNSoj8YXcgo;full][/previewyoutube]

🌑 Asteroid Caves
We’ve expanded cave environments for deeper exploration and mystery.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/af0954ecaa888f0c5e287b6654320ac4c311ccc2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/3ceb54b65f4bfa7b33e9e60f295769ff61c35ec8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/1a1eff1647bee8333cb3fcc509855221483ad030.png

🤖 Grab Tool & Space Mines
This new tool lets you grab objects in zero-G — from environmental items to dangerous floating mines. It’ll also help with puzzle solving.

[previewyoutube=mf5_Kqmd2kM;full][/previewyoutube]

🧱 Habitat Wall Styles + Decorations
You can now change interior walls of your habitat rooms, add small decorations, place shelves, and personalize your space even more.

[previewyoutube=9j6-mCXhkhY;full][/previewyoutube]

🎨 Habitat Posters
Posters are collectible items you can find and hang in your base. Decorate like a true space miner.

[previewyoutube=k9rmll44Yj8;full][/previewyoutube]

🪐 New Floating Islands & Space Ads
New explorable islands and mysterious space billboards are scattered across the belts, each with unique story elements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/9a969451a6148160d239783c88c2e05af707818a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/90efecce0075b6b6c282b2ed97dae03f959ce904.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/01c5c5e0fb8566564983fff8f392d6b9ad433a79.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/92cbfd11940107960785a37cfbd73cc852ed7506.png

🚀 Vehicle Landing Pads & Teleportation
Land your vehicle directly onto designated landing pads and even teleport vehicles between locations. Navigation just got smoother.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/90b074dc8dbf492336dbcc530e262fce94386d50.png
[previewyoutube=In64g8zvFAk;full][/previewyoutube]

🛠️ Skipper Upgrades
The Skipper vehicle is now upgradable! Boost, speed, and charge enhancements available — and yes, you can now dock it too.

[previewyoutube=vO9HhxIuyE4;full][/previewyoutube]

🔧 Vehicle Repair & Charge Stations
Build stations inside your docking area to automatically repair or recharge docked vehicles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/48a69526c63123b568b03326e6635cb413e5224a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/4a2ec165ffd94c6ace16d86e18bebd6f1da9add7.jpg

[previewyoutube=FtuYsgjzi2g;full][/previewyoutube]

Introducing Nanite Batteries & Power Cells — twice the performance of standard cells.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119378/a597ebad9495e69e325c6b4599eea3d5b0e1c5c2.png

🔫 Summon Vehicle Weapon
Your summon vehicle is now armed! Use it for asteroid mining or defense.

[previewyoutube=moWnHTiGBjg;full][/previewyoutube]

⚙️ Graphics Updates & New Options
We’ve added DLSS, FSR 3, and new Lumen lighting options for players who want the best visuals... or want to melt their GPUs 😅

✨ Particle Improvements
Mining tool and scrapper effects now look even better!

🎮 General Improvements


 Better marker systems

notes.content:

First off, a huge thank you to all of you for supporting us. Whether you’re playing, sharing feedback, or contributing to our amazing community wiki, we’re beyond grateful. If you haven’t seen it yet, check out the wiki here:
👉 Astrometica Wiki

Now, let’s go over what’s coming next.

New Environments and Locations

 Environment Overhaul

Building and Construction Feedback: Your input on building and construction mechanics has been instrumental in our development process. We're thrilled to announce that we've been working on a new snapping system for our habitat building, which will be implemented in the prologue version of the game. notes.title: Exciting Times Ahead for Astrometica
notes.content:
Hello Astrometica Pioneers,


Your unwavering support and enthusiasm continue to fuel our journey. The demo has been an incredible experience, and we're thrilled to share a brief update on our upcoming plans.

Firstly, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks. The overwhelming response to our demo has been nothing short of astonishing, resulting in over 6000 wishlists. It's heartwarming to know that you're as excited as we are for the adventures to come.

Now, let's talk about the big picture. While the demo provides just a glimpse of what Astrometica has to offer, the full game is a vast universe with countless stories and adventures. Our target is to launch the Early Access version in Q1-Q2 2024. And, yes, more playtests are on the horizon, so you'll have plenty of opportunities to dive deeper into the world of Astrometica.
